findings.note: Principal author of House Bill 788 (2026), 'Affidavit ballot; allow to serve as voter registration in certain situations.' It would make the affidavit ballot of an eligible voter who was not registered in that jurisdiction serve as that voter's registration, and return an inactive-status voter to active status when he or she casts an affidavit ballot. Date shown is the day it was referred to the House Apportionment and Elections committee. The record lists the bill as dead.
